scenarios.title: the desk, the pill and a sheet in the theme's colours after Commons.Color, on the test host's Qt (WP-224)
scenarios.notes: Qt 6.11.2 (qt6-declarative), theme Tokyo Night. The desk summoned at Today (shot), then Decisions and d typed with wtype: the New decision form open (view form.open true, shot), lastError empty. In both shots the desk's pixels hold exactly the theme's background #1a1b26, foreground #a9b1d6 and accent #7aa2f7 from ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml, the bar the same foreground; no black text. Esc and hide closed the desk

limitations: edge: not run (no edge host in the yellow zone); the test host runs Omarchy's rc channel, and switching it to edge is not this release's test. Covered by fixture: the real edge pacman.log lines of a switch in tests/drift.rs (one omarchy-channel item, a second capture 0 events), the twins in nine transaction shapes; and by the full check on the edge dev host (headless)
desk: the pill showed no text (0 crises, driftInBar crisis), so its colours were seen only as the bar's foreground; the other sheets are covered headless by service-states on edge (the dev host)
restart: one monitor (1920x1080); the two-monitor restart test runs on the dev host after the tag with the release
channel: the test host runs Omarchy's rc channel with Qt 6.11.2, not stable (E93); Qt 6.12 (edge) was covered headless on the dev host only
